# Website

The website (https://fesmc.github.io/FesmData/) is a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) site
in `docs/`. Most pages include a README of the repository (the datasets, `Remap/`,
`Records/`, `shared/`, `Publish/`, `Figures/`), so that they are written once, next to
the code; the pages for users (Home, Download, Products, Domains, Datasets, Precision)
are written in `docs/`. The menus are set in `docs/_quarto.yml`.

Some parts are generated by `julia fesmdata.jl docs` (`Publish/site.jl`, standard
library only), and not tracked:

| File | Contents | From |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/_products.md` | The table of the datasets on each domain, with their versions (Products) | `registry/` |
| `docs/_downloads/<Dataset>.md` | The files of each grid of a dataset, with their links (Downloads, at the end of its page) | `registry/` |
| `docs/_datasets.md`, `docs/_records.md` | The overview of the datasets by topic, and of the records | `Publish/datasets.toml` (`[_site] topics`), `registry/` |
| `docs/_domains.md` | The table of the domains (Domains) | `shared/domains.toml`, `Topo/products.toml` |
| `docs/_figures.md` | The README of the figures, with its include line escaped, for this page | `Figures/README.md` |

Each dataset page ends with figures of its products, made from the released files on
Levante and committed (`docs/figures/<Dataset>/`, by `julia fesmdata.jl figures
<Dataset>`, see below). The overview figures of the domains linked from the table of the
domains are `docs/figures/Domains/<folder>_TOPO-<product>.png`.

`.github/workflows/publish-docs.yml` renders the site and publishes it to the `gh-pages`
branch on every push to main that changes the docs, the READMEs, the registry or
Publish. To preview it locally:

```bash
julia fesmdata.jl docs
quarto preview docs
```
